title: Plenary: Performance Matters - Emery Berger - CppCon 2020
summary: Emery Berger's CppCon 2020 plenary on why performance is hard on modern hardware after the end of Dennard scaling. It covers benchmarking pitfalls and introduces new profiling tools for finding real bottlenecks.
why: Recommended for treating benchmarking and profiling scientifically rather than by myth, with innovative tools.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: covers the basics of how to attempt benchmarking with actual computer science instead of myth and voodoo rituals
